title: Bluesky Launches Saved Post Feature
excerpt: Bluesky, the social media startup, has finally rolled out the most in-demand feature for its users: private bookmarks.
imageAlt: Editorial illustration of a bookmark on a blue sky background
body:
Bluesky, the social media startup, has finally rolled out the most in-demand feature for its users: private bookmarks. On September 8, 2025, its website and app featured the update, allowing you to save the posts to view later. You can access the newest addition under each post and view it any time by visiting the 'saved' section of the application.

## How Bluesky's Bookmarks Feature Ensures More Privacy?

Bluesky, which saw a surge in popularity after millions of users abandoned X (formerly Twitter) and joined the new platform, serves as a perfect alternative with enhanced user data security. It used to feature a 'pinned' feed, letting you save posts using a 'pin emoji.' This alternative method was not private, allowing others to monitor your activity and even permitting them to leave a public reply.

With Bluesky presenting the bookmarks option, it has changed the privacy factor on the platform, keeping every saved post secure from unwanted replies. This handy tool has greatly made your activity more private. However, it still needs work, as the posts can't be categorized into separate folders at present.

title: Google Photos Adds Conversational AI Editing
excerpt: Google has redefined photo editing with Google Photos, with AI-powered editing, expanding the feature to more Android devices after carefully reviewing it with the Pixel 10 lineup.
imageAlt: Editorial illustration of a photo frame with an AI editing sparkle
body:
Google has redefined photo editing with Google Photos, with AI-powered editing, expanding the feature to more Android devices after carefully reviewing it with the Pixel 10 lineup. Gemini's advanced AI will enhance the pictures, and you can access this feature by tapping the "Help me edit" option in the app.

Previously, the app presented a variety of tools and sliders to enhance the quality and get the desired effect, but with the newest feature, you can describe your needs in a prompt, which will produce the desired outcome. This approach not only cuts short the time on the editing process but also opens the door to having professional-looking results.

## How Does Google Gemini Lift the Pictures?

Google's game-changing update has made editing child's play, but how can you utilize this feature? You can follow the simple steps to get your dream edits:

- Tap on the 'Edit' option, and select "Help me edit."

- You can write or speak your desired edits, and the AI will present you with multiple edited images with the prompts mentioned.

- You can either select from the multitude of enhanced versions that meet your expectations or simply add more prompts to get your dream image.

The edited images will feature a watermark to ensure transparency that the picture was edited using artificial intelligence. You can access the update on your Android devices if you’re 18 or older and the feature is compatible with Google Photos version 7.42.

Google's recent breakthrough in image editing showcases its commitment to enhancing your experience, making it truly appealing. They are putting the efficiency to the test by making adjustments and working with even vague and less detailed commands.

title: Using Narrative to Create Impactful Designs
excerpt: Integrating narrative into your creative endeavours may help your users have a happier and more memorable environment.
imageAlt: An illustrated path connecting the stages of a story
body:
Integrating narrative into your creative endeavours may help your users have a happier and more memorable environment. One may build a design that tells a captivating tale by comprehending the story one wants to convey, using graphics and typography to establish the tone, developing relevant user personas, and producing a powerful narrative.

Adding narrative into creative work is a powerful approach to bring depth and significance to the end result, whether it is a web page, mobile application, or real item. Storytelling may elicit sentiments, engage with the client, and enhance the whole engagement.

To include storytelling in design work, you must first have a clear idea of the narrative you want to convey. Spend some time comprehending the tale you want to communicate before you begin the drafting process. This might be the tale of your company, merchandise, or users. Once you've developed a solid knowledge of the background information, you can utilise it to influence your design selections.

Visuals are an effective narrative tool. Use graphics, drawings, and videos to assist express your message. Contemplate the feelings and ideas you intend to generate, and then select graphics that complement those aims. If you're creating an online presence for an ecological park, for example, utilise photographs of the place's beauty, wildlife, and people to describe the feeling of being there.

Another effective method for telling stories is typography. Select typefaces that convey the tone and atmosphere of the tale you wish to portray. A whimsical typeface, for example, would be ideal for an educational app, whilst a more sober font would possibly be right for an economic management webpage. The typeface may assist to build a unified story and establish an atmosphere for every aspect of the experience.

A compelling story may connect all of the parts of your design. Analyse how every design component adds to the message that you wish to convey as well as how they interact to form a unified storyline. The story may be conveyed in several ways, such as the style of the web page, the structure of the application's interface, or the way the item is packaged.

title: The Science Behind Typography: How It Enhances Design
excerpt: A well-chosen typeface may elicit a wide range of feelings and sentiments, represent a brand's identity, and construct an information hierarchy.
imageAlt: A typographic composition of serif and sans-serif letterforms
body:
A well-chosen typeface may elicit a wide range of feelings and sentiments, represent a brand's identity, and construct an information hierarchy. Continue reading to see how a well-designed typographic system may improve user interaction by rendering it simpler for consumers to explore and interact with the information.

Typography is an essential component of design that may greatly influence how viewers perceive and engage with visual information. The art and practice of organizing typefaces, fonts, as well as other design components to produce an eye-catching and useful design are known as typography. An eye-guiding visual hierarchy may be created by using effective typography, which can also aid to communicate a message and setting the mood.

Readability is considered to be among the most important elements of typography. A message might be lost in a poorly executed design that is hard to comprehend or navigate. Even from a distance, readable, understandable font should be able to be read. To maintain consistency and continuity, it should be uniform throughout all design factors.

Typography's capacity to establish an information architecture that directs the viewer's attention is another crucial feature. The most crucial information may be highlighted with the aid of a well-designed hierarchy, which can also give the design a feeling of harmony and proportion. For instance, different font choices, patterns, and colours may be used to build headers, subsections, and paragraphs to establish an aesthetically pleasing structure that directs the viewer's attention through the layout and displays the most important information.

Moreover, typography is a crucial component of brand identification.

A brand's visual language may be developed with a well-designed typographic system. It represents a brand's personality, beliefs, and mission while also assisting in the creation of a distinct and distinctive identity that distinguishes it from rivals. To establish a unified and consistent brand identity, a consistent font system may be employed throughout a variety of design components, such as packaging, promotional materials, and webpages.

In conclusion, typography is an important design component that may influence how viewers react to and engage with visual information. Good typography may produce an aesthetically compelling and striking look, improve readability and legibility, develop a consistent and identifiable brand identity, and create a visual hierarchy. To make sure that designs are efficient, compelling, and effectively communicate the desired message, careful consideration of typography is imperative.
